invariants.rationale: The method throws an exception if actor == this, so at exit it cannot be.
The last assignment in the method is this.actor = actor, so they are equal at exit.
If actor is not null, super.addActor(actor) is called, making this the parent.

invariants.expression: actor == null || actor != this.actor || actor.getParent() == this
invariants.rationale: If actor is not null and equals this.actor, its parent must be this container.
If actor is not null, it still isn't this (container), by the initial guard.
